Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning: capacity uplift & QBR timing

Hi Emma —

Following our usage spike last quarter, we wanted to kick off renewal planning and map a short mutual action plan so we can lock capacity and avoid any service friction during your peak. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm target uplift (throughput / concurrent sessions) and preferred term (12 vs 24 months)
- Identify procurement POC and preferred billing cadence
- Lock a QBR window to review run-rate, forecasting, and the uplift/discount proposal

Attached: mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf (one-pager), and a usage appendix (usage-metrics-oct-2026.csv).

Proposed timeline (we can compress if you need faster turnaround):
- This week: confirm procurement POC + target uplift
- Next week: Rishi to share pricing options and term scenarios
- Week of Nov 8: QBR (30–45m) to finalize commitment and sequencing for burst credits

Suggested stakeholders to include in the QBR:
- Emma (Product owner)
- Maya D'Souza (Procurement)
- Marissa Cole (CSM - Redwood)
- Rishi Malhotra (AE - Redwood)
- Chloe Martin (Sales Ops lead / kickoff owner)

If you prefer a poll instead of back-and-forth, I dropped a Calendly poll link in the follow-up I’ll send after this thread.

Thanks — happy to adapt the timeline if you have a hard renewal date.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Development Manager | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Chloe — thanks for the clear next steps. We're definitely interested in locking more capacity; last quarter's peak caught us off-guard and we need a predictable burst path. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Target uplift: initially +2x concurrent throughput; we may add a staging burst for seasonal load in Q1
- Term: leaning toward a 12-month commit with an option to extend to 24 months at pre-negotiated pricing
- Procurement POC: procurement@orionfin.com (looping them now) — Maya D'Souza will be the lead on contracts

Week of Nov 8 works for a QBR for our product and procurement teams. Can you share a short pre-read with pricing scenarios before the QBR so we can scope internally?

Emma

Hi Emma — appreciate the quick reply and Maya loop. I’ll put together three concrete options to discuss in the QBR so you have something to run past finance/procurement:

1) Capacity-First (12mo): 2x baseline throughput commit, 10% list discount, monthly billing
2) Term-Saver (24mo): 2x baseline throughput commit, 18% list discount, quarter billing + guaranteed renewal price cap
3) Burst Allowance Add-on: 50k tokens/month burst credits for peak events (billed on use) — combinable with either option

I’ll attach an initial pricing sheet and a short model showing cost delta vs current run-rate. Can we book a 30min prep call (internal + Emma + Maya + Marissa) the week before Nov 8 to align on the agenda and pre-reads? Proposed slots: Nov 3 10:00am PT, Nov 4 2:00pm PT.

Attaching: pricing-options-orionfin.xlsx

Thanks — Rishi
